notes: Month-end snapshot per Republic, RQII and region. A year row (month = All) uses the last month on record.
Compliance = assets not overdue / assets. Overdue = more than 30 days past the calibration due date. Long pending (p90) = more than 90 days past due.
Pending buckets are days past due: p0_30 (still within the grace period), p31_60, p61_90.
Asset groups: res residential meters, nres non-residential meters, bal balance meters, sen pressure sensors, total all assets.
BRQİİ and BRQSD are combined as BRQİİ / BRQSD.
